title: Legacy explorer selection
responsibility: Maps an earlier console selection to the corresponding explorer entity and section.

inputs.name: explorerLegacy.route
inputs.description: Legacy route with branch, commit, view and optional unit.

outputs.name: explorerLegacy
outputs.description: Explorer location preserving branch and commit. No unit opens Pages; a selected unit opens its kind category, defaulting to functions, with history section for history or growth views.
